notes: Backs: a scuff, stain or long scratch on a blue back now counts toward the surface grade. Before, a back whose border was busy with tiny print dots and dust specks had every mark on it ignored. Small light specks there still don't count (they're usually dust on the glass).
Odds & value: a Japanese card typed with its English name and number (Altaria 074/068) finds the Japanese card. Backs: torn-off surface counts as damage (about a PSA 4).
